retention.title: Data retention
retention.description: Deactivated records are deleted for good on the date shown, unless you keep them.
retention.keepDescription: "{{label}}" will not be deleted. It stays deactivated.
retention.purgeDescription: "{{label}}" will be erased right away. This cannot be undone.
retention.emptyDescription: Deactivated records will show up here before they are deleted.
